newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says signs SDH contracts in China.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says signs SDH contracts in China.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Friday it signed two strategic synchronous digital hierarchy (SDH) contracts in China.
Ericsson signed one contract with Shandong Post & Telecommunication Administration which included transport network solutions.
"This SDH contract is a breakthrough for Ericsson's fibre solutions in the Shangdong province, which has a population of 88 million," Ericsson said in a statement.
A second contract was signed with the Ningbo Telecommunication Bureau for deliveries of SDH transport network solutions enabling services at up to 2.5 Gbps.
Deliveries for the two contracts will start in April and are expected to be running by the end of 1997, Ericsson said without disclosing the value of the contracts.
